commands.name: list-featured-collections
commands.summary: List the featured collections shown in the homepage 'Explore' carousel (for example BBC Heritage Collection), with title, description and link

commands.name: list-collection-categories
commands.summary: List the top-level collection themes on the homepage (for example Medicine), with their description and subcategory text (for example Pharmacology, Surgery, Asian medicine)

commands.name: list-anniversaries
commands.summary: List the homepage 'anniversary' highlights: collection objects linked to events from N years ago today, with the anniversary text and a link to the object
